name: Geometric Constraint Disguise
description: Replaced the algebraic edge constraint with a geometric tangency condition (circles with radii in {1,2} centered 3 units apart intersecting at exactly one point). This traps pattern-matching models into categorizing the task as computational geometry, while reasoning models will deduce that tangency requires the radii to sum to 3, meaning adjacent nodes must have different values, thereby revealing the underlying 2-coloring structure.
